The bristles are soft enough to be safe on sensitive vintage carpets and delicate cloth upholstery, yet firm enough to break up dried mud, beach sand, road grime, food spills, pet hair, and the kind of set-in stains that resist a basic wipe-down. Mist the surface, agitate with the brush in short overlapping passes, then wipe the lifted soil away with a clean microfiber towel. A single brush belongs in every interior detailing kit alongside your favorite microfiber towels and cabin cleaners.
